company_name: United Continental Holdings, Inc. (fka Continental Airlines, Inc.)

fuel_consumption.source_quote: Impact of $1 increase in price per barrel of aircraft fuel on annual fuel expense (based on 2015 projected fuel consumption): $93 million (implies ~3,906 million projected gallons for 2015).

instrument_type_details.notes: UAL consolidated at Dec 31, 2014: 22% of 2015 fuel (859 million gallons) and 1% of 2016 (35 million gallons) hedged. Instruments based on aircraft fuel or crude oil. Fair value liability $717 million (large liability due to oil price crash in H2 2014). $577 million collateral deposited with counterparties. Hedges expiring through March 2016.

warnings: Large fuel hedge liability of -$717M due to sharp oil price decline in 2014. $577M collateral deposited.
